name: lamori_a
label: lambda Ori A (Meissa, O9 III)
sources: Wikipedia infobox (read 2026-10-08) and the papers it cites: V 3.7, O9 III((f)) giant, T_eff 36000 K, R 10.0 Rsun, M 28.0 Msun, d 390 pc, log g 3.9
notes: No interferometric diameter exists: theta_LD = 2R/d = 0.238 mas from the quoted radius and distance; the Pathfinder would be its first measurement.
Claret & Bloemen 2011 linear law of Spica (hot B star) as the limb-darkening fallback; NewEra does not cover T_eff > 12 000 K.
V 3.7 is the A component; lambda Ori B (B0.5 V, V 5.6, 4.4 arcsec away) must be excluded by the camera's field stop.
Distance 390 pc from the Gaia parallax 2.59 +/- 0.40 mas (uncertain: +/- 15 %).
